subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Reverse Auctions
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Reverse Auctions.

hook.text: Suppliers compete live online, each undercutting the other. The price drops 25% in 30 minutes.

buildup.text: In a reverse auction, suppliers bid against each other in real time to win your business at the lowest price.

discovery.text: It creates intense price competition and market transparency. Buyers see exactly what the market will bear.

twist.text: Overusing reverse auctions damages supplier relationships. Suppliers feel commoditized and cut corners to win.

climax.text: Use reverse auctions for commodities with many suppliers—not for complex services where quality matters most.

punchline.text: Auctions reveal market prices. Use them wisely.

quiz.question: When are reverse auctions most appropriate?
